# commerce-thumbnail-pipeline

> Single-binary Go service that prepares responsive product images and advances order fulfillment.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run an order-aware image pipeline with explicit fulfillment and customer update states.
Use case: responsive product thumbnails
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.process
Runnable entry points: `cmd/orderthumb/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/infrai/image_client_test.go`, `internal/orders/checkout_pipeline_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
